title: Engineering note: token bucket
text: A token bucket refills at a fixed rate up to a maximum capacity; each request consumes a token. Unused tokens accumulate, so the algorithm allows bursts up to the bucket capacity while enforcing the average rate. In a multi-instance deployment the token count must live in shared storage such as Redis, updated atomically.
